title: Lower bounds for the low Steklov eigenvalues
summary: For a compact, connected, orientable Riemannian manifold with $b$ boundary components, we obtain geometric lower bounds for the low Steklov eigenvalues, namely $σ_k$, $1\le k\le b-1$. Our results complement earlier results, which apply only to $σ_k$ with $k\ge b$ and depend on the geometry near the boundary, by showing how the interior geometry influences the low eigenvalues. Our result also yields lower bounds for the low Steklov eigenvalues in the setting of pinched negatively curved manifolds, thus recovering similar results in that context through an alternative proof.
